verdict.rationale: Riveter ships an official Go SDK (riveterhq/riveter-go) with documented client code (riveter.EnrichParams), and docs describe SDK-level handling of auth, retries, long-polling, and pagination, indicating a first-party SDK layer built for AI-native workflows. Missing for 10: confirmation of additional language SDKs (e.g., Python/JS) beyond Go, and independent/hands-on corroboration of SDK reliability.
